content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 7.2 (first instance, p0026) contained an MFN running against us — an open-ended duty to disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable third-party offer before engaging another provider. With no product limit, no 12-month cap and no like-for-like carve-outs, it fails all three fallback elements and is walk-away territory; it also contradicts Section 12.3's acknowledgement that we made no most-favoured-customer commitment. I proposed the preferred cure: a single surgical replacement removing the obligation and stating we owe no disclosure or matching duty, leaving all Vendor-side pricing protections intact.
